title: So that York might not lose
html_source: He’s taken on this group responsibility (in contrast to the soccer field, where he hadn’t).

anchor.text: so that York might not lose
anchor.prefix: rd and he felt confused. The little silk badge with the white rose on it that was pinned on the breast of his jacket began to flutter. He was no good at sums but he tried his best
anchor.suffix:
. Father Arnall’s face looked very black but he was not in a wax: he was laughing. Then Jack Lawton cracked his fingers and Father Arnall looked at his copybook and said:

 —Right.
